newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL shares close at 8-month low, UEM leads falls.
newsitem.headline: KL shares close at 8-month low, UEM leads falls.

text.p: The market fell to an eight-month low as selling continued on a broad slate of blue chip stocks, dealers and analysts said.
Heavy selling in engineering stock United Engineers was also a key factor dragging down the market.

United Engineers (UEM) dropped 90 cents to 17.80 ringgit on continued worries it will be used by the Renong group to buy into loss-making National Steel Corp (NSC) of the Phillipines. Renong fell 20 cents to 3.32.
At the close, the key Composite Index fell 14.59 points or 1.34 percent to 1,074.86.
This is the index's lowest since it hit 1,087.97 points on August 1 last year.
"The NSC issue continued to weigh down sentiment for core stocks, UEM slumped...on heavy institutional selling...," G.K. Stockbrokers said in its market commentary.
The market's fall accelerated in afternoon dealings after breaking support level at 1,080 points, with the key index next support level seen at 1,050.
"The market should be holding at this level but downside potential at 1,050 is there," said a dealer at Arab-Malaysian Securities.
